Package com.csse3200.game.perks.tortoises

Class TortoisePlanner

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.perks.tortoises.TortoisePlanner
public final class TortoisePlanner extends Object
Decides, once per new game, how many tortoises there are and which maps hold the random ones.

The total is rolled from FIXED_TORTOISES to MAX_TOTAL. The fixed tortoises (the ones placed on a map plus Zeus's drop) always exist and count towards it; the rest are shared between the maps by weighted draw:

  • each of the eight rooms has one slot, weighted ROOM_WEIGHT, so a room is likelier to hold one than a main level;
  • each main level has up to MAX_PER_LEVEL slots (Level 3 only LEVEL_3_MAX), weighted less the higher the level, so the chance falls as the player climbs.

Because the plan is made up front, a total of 12 can always be reached. Nothing here touches the game; TortoiseCarrierAssigner turns the plan into carriers when a map is built.

      public static Map<String,Integer> plan(int total, List<String> rooms, Map<String,Float> levelWeights, Random random)
      Shares the random tortoises (the total minus the fixed ones) between the maps, never giving a room more than one, a main level more than MAX_PER_LEVEL or Level 3 more than LEVEL_3_MAX.
      Parameters:
      total - the rolled total, FIXED_TORTOISES to MAX_TOTAL
      rooms - the room map names, one slot each
      levelWeights - main level map name to the weight of each of its slots
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      map name to how many random tortoises it holds; maps with none are left out
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the total is out of range
